    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">【学习笔记】《Python编程 从入门到实践》第3章：Python列表完全指南——创建、修改、删除与排序</span>
    

</a>
</h1>
		</div>
		<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">

<h1 data-heading="第3章 列表简介">第3章 列表简介</h1>
<blockquote>
<p>本章目标：理解列表的概念，掌握创建、访问、修改、删除列表元素的方法，学会组织列表的常用操作。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h2 data-heading="3.1 列表是什么">3.1 列表是什么</h2>
<p><strong>列表</strong> 由一系列按特定顺序排列的元素组成。用方括号 <code>[]</code> 表示，逗号分隔元素。</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">bicycles = ['trek', 'cannondale', 'redline', 'specialized']
print(bicycles)
# ['trek', 'cannondale', 'redline', 'specialized']
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>建议给列表指定<strong>复数名称</strong>，如 <code>letters</code>、<code>digits</code>、<code>names</code>。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 data-heading="3.1.1 访问列表元素">3.1.1 访问列表元素</h3>
<p>通过索引（从 0 开始）访问：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">bicycles = ['trek', 'cannondale', 'redline', 'specialized']
print(bicycles[0])                 # trek
print(bicycles[0].title())         # Trek（可对元素调用字符串方法）
</code></pre>
<h3 data-heading="3.1.2 索引从 0 而不是 1 开始">3.1.2 索引从 0 而不是 1 开始</h3>
<pre><code class="language-python">bicycles = ['trek', 'cannondale', 'redline', 'specialized']
print(bicycles[1])     # cannondale（第二个元素）
print(bicycles[3])     # specialized（第四个元素）
<h1 id="负索引-1-表示最后一个元素">负索引：-1 表示最后一个元素</h1>
</code><p><code class="language-python">print(bicycles[-1])    # specialized<br>
print(bicycles[-2])    # redline（倒数第二个）<br>
print(bicycles[-3])    # cannondale<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<h3 data-heading="3.1.3 使用列表中的各个值">3.1.3 使用列表中的各个值</h3>
<pre><code class="language-python">bicycles = ['trek', 'cannondale', 'redline', 'specialized']
message = "My first bicycle was a " + bicycles[0].title() + "."
print(message)
# My first bicycle was a Trek.
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 data-heading="3.2 修改、添加和删除元素">3.2 修改、添加和删除元素</h2>
<h3 data-heading="3.2.1 修改列表元素">3.2.1 修改列表元素</h3>
<p>直接通过索引赋值：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">motorcycles = ['honda', 'yamaha', 'suzuki']
motorcycles[0] = 'ducati'
print(motorcycles)
# ['ducati', 'yamaha', 'suzuki']
</code></pre>
<h3 data-heading="3.2.2 在列表中添加元素">3.2.2 在列表中添加元素</h3>
<p><strong><code>append()</code></strong> — 在末尾添加：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">motorcycles = ['honda', 'yamaha', 'suzuki']
motorcycles.append('ducati')
print(motorcycles)
# ['honda', 'yamaha', 'suzuki', 'ducati']
<h1 id="常用模式先建空列表再-append">常用模式：先建空列表，再 append</h1>
<p>motorcycles = []<br>
motorcycles.append('honda')<br>
motorcycles.append('yamaha')<br>
motorcycles.append('suzuki')<br>
print(motorcycles)</p>
<h1 id="honda-yamaha-suzuki">['honda', 'yamaha', 'suzuki']</h1>
</code><p><code class="language-python"></code></p></pre><p></p>
<p><strong><code>insert()</code></strong> — 在任意位置插入（指定索引和值）：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">motorcycles = ['honda', 'yamaha', 'suzuki']
motorcycles.insert(0, 'ducati')
print(motorcycles)
# ['ducati', 'honda', 'yamaha', 'suzuki']
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p><code>insert(0, 'ducati')</code> 在索引 0 处插入，原有元素右移。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 data-heading="3.2.3 从列表中删除元素">3.2.3 从列表中删除元素</h3>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>方法</th><th>用法</th><th>特点</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>del</code></td>
<td><code>del list[index]</code></td>
<td>删除后无法再访问该值</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>pop()</code></td>
<td><code>list.pop()</code></td>
<td>删除末尾元素并返回该值</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>pop(index)</code></td>
<td><code>list.pop(index)</code></td>
<td>删除任意位置元素并返回</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>remove()</code></td>
<td><code>list.remove(value)</code></td>
<td>按值删除第一个匹配项</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><strong><code>del</code> 语句</strong> — 按位置删除（不再需要该值）：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">motorcycles = ['honda', 'yamaha', 'suzuki']
del motorcycles[0]
print(motorcycles)
# ['yamaha', 'suzuki']
<p>del motorcycles[1]<br>
print(motorcycles)</p>
<h1 id="honda-suzuki">['honda', 'suzuki']</h1>
</code><p><code class="language-python"></code></p></pre><p></p>
<p><strong><code>pop()</code> 方法</strong> — 删除并继续使用该值：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python"># 默认弹出末尾
motorcycles = ['honda', 'yamaha', 'suzuki']
popped_motorcycle = motorcycles.pop()
print(motorcycles)           # ['honda', 'yamaha']
print(popped_motorcycle)     # suzuki
<h1 id="使用弹出的值">使用弹出的值</h1>
</code><p><code class="language-python">last_owned = motorcycles.pop()<br>
print("The last motorcycle I owned was a " + last_owned.title() + ".")<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<p><strong><code>pop(index)</code></strong> — 弹出任意位置：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">motorcycles = ['honda', 'yamaha', 'suzuki']
first_owned = motorcycles.pop(0)
print('The first motorcycle I owned was a ' + first_owned.title() + '.')
# The first motorcycle I owned was a Honda.
</code></pre>
<p><strong>判断标准</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>删除后<strong>不再使用</strong> → <code>del</code></li>
<li>删除后<strong>还要使用</strong> → <code>pop()</code></li>
</ul>
<p><strong><code>remove()</code></strong> — 按值删除（只删第一个匹配项）：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">motorcycles = ['honda', 'yamaha', 'suzuki', 'ducati']
motorcycles.remove('ducati')
print(motorcycles)
# ['honda', 'yamaha', 'suzuki']
<h1 id="可先用变量存储删除后继续使用该值">可先用变量存储，删除后继续使用该值</h1>
<p>too_expensive = 'ducati'<br>
motorcycles.remove(too_expensive)<br>
print("\nA " + too_expensive.title() + " is too expensive for me.")</p>
<h1 id="a-ducati-is-too-expensive-for-me">A Ducati is too expensive for me.</h1>
</code><p><code class="language-python"></code></p></pre><p></p>
<blockquote>
<p>⚠️ <code>remove()</code> 只删除第一个匹配值。多个重复值需要用循环处理（第 7 章）。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h2 data-heading="3.3 组织列表">3.3 组织列表</h2>
<h3 data-heading="3.3.1 `sort()` — 永久排序">3.3.1 <code>sort()</code> — 永久排序</h3>
<pre><code class="language-python">cars = ['bmw', 'audi', 'toyota', 'subaru']
cars.sort()
print(cars)
# ['audi', 'bmw', 'subaru', 'toyota']
<h1 id="倒序排列">倒序排列</h1>
<p>cars.sort(reverse=True)<br>
print(cars)</p>
<h1 id="toyota-subaru-bmw-audi">['toyota', 'subaru', 'bmw', 'audi']</h1>
</code><p><code class="language-python"></code></p></pre><p></p>
<blockquote>
<p><code>sort()</code> 永久修改列表顺序，不可恢复。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 data-heading="3.3.2 `sorted()` — 临时排序">3.3.2 <code>sorted()</code> — 临时排序</h3>
<pre><code class="language-python">cars = ['bmw', 'audi', 'toyota', 'subaru']
print("Here is the original list:")
print(cars)
<p>print("\nHere is the sorted list:")<br>
print(sorted(cars))</p>
<p>print("\nHere is the original list again:")<br>
print(cars)</p>
<h1 id="倒序临时排序">倒序临时排序</h1>
</code><p><code class="language-python">print(sorted(cars, reverse=True))<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<blockquote>
<p><code>sorted()</code> 返回排序后的副本，不修改原列表。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 data-heading="3.3.3 `reverse()` — 反转列表">3.3.3 <code>reverse()</code> — 反转列表</h3>
<pre><code class="language-python">cars = ['bmw', 'audi', 'toyota', 'subaru']
cars.reverse()
print(cars)
# ['subaru', 'toyota', 'audi', 'bmw']
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p><code>reverse()</code> 永久反转顺序，再次调用可恢复。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 data-heading="3.3.4 `len()` — 获取列表长度">3.3.4 <code>len()</code> — 获取列表长度</h3>
<pre><code class="language-python">&gt;&gt;&gt; cars = ['bmw', 'audi', 'toyota', 'subaru']
&gt;&gt;&gt; len(cars)
4
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 data-heading="3.4 使用列表时避免索引错误">3.4 使用列表时避免索引错误</h2>
<p><strong><code>IndexError: list index out of range</code></strong> — 索引超出列表范围：</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">motorcycles = ['honda', 'yamaha', 'suzuki']
print(motorcycles[3])    # ❌ IndexError（只有索引 0, 1, 2）
</code></pre>
<p><strong>解决方法</strong>：</p>
<ol>
<li>尝试将索引减 1</li>
<li>使用 <code>-1</code> 访问最后一个元素（仅在列表非空时有效）</li>
<li>将列表或其长度打印出来，查看实际内容</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-python"># 空列表使用 -1 也会出错
motorcycles = []
print(motorcycles[-1])   # ❌ IndexError
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 data-heading="动手试一试">动手试一试</h2>
<h3 data-heading="3-1 姓名">3-1 姓名</h3>
<pre><code class="language-python">names = ['Alice', 'Bob', 'Charlie']
print(names[0])
print(names[1])
print(names[2])
</code></pre>
<h3 data-heading="3-2 问候语">3-2 问候语</h3>
<pre><code class="language-python">names = ['Alice', 'Bob', 'Charlie']
print("Hello, " + names[0] + "!")
print("Hello, " + names[1] + "!")
print("Hello, " + names[2] + "!")
</code></pre>
<h3 data-heading="3-3 自己的列表">3-3 自己的列表</h3>
<pre><code class="language-python">commute = ['motorcycle', 'car', 'bike']
print("I would like to own a Honda " + commute[0] + ".")
</code></pre>
<h3 data-heading="3-4 ~ 3-7 嘉宾名单系列">3-4 ~ 3-7 嘉宾名单系列</h3>
<pre><code class="language-python"># 3-4 嘉宾名单
guests = ['Einstein', 'Mozart', 'Curie']
print("Dear " + guests[0] + ", please join me for dinner.")
print("Dear " + guests[1] + ", please join me for dinner.")
print("Dear " + guests[2] + ", please join me for dinner.")
<h1 id="3-5-修改嘉宾名单">3-5 修改嘉宾名单</h1>
<p>print("\n" + guests[1] + " can't make it.")<br>
guests[1] = 'Newton'<br>
print("Dear " + guests[0] + ", please join me for dinner.")<br>
print("Dear " + guests[1] + ", please join me for dinner.")<br>
print("Dear " + guests[2] + ", please join me for dinner.")</p>
<h1 id="3-6-添加嘉宾">3-6 添加嘉宾</h1>
<p>print("\nI found a bigger table!")<br>
guests.insert(0, 'Da Vinci')<br>
guests.insert(2, 'Shakespeare')<br>
guests.append('Tesla')<br>
print("Dear " + guests[0] + ", please join me for dinner.")<br>
print("Dear " + guests[1] + ", please join me for dinner.")<br>
print("Dear " + guests[2] + ", please join me for dinner.")<br>
print("Dear " + guests[3] + ", please join me for dinner.")<br>
print("Dear " + guests[4] + ", please join me for dinner.")<br>
print("Dear " + guests[5] + ", please join me for dinner.")</p>
<h1 id="3-7-缩减名单">3-7 缩减名单</h1>
</code><p><code class="language-python">print("\nSorry, I can only invite two people for dinner.")<br>
popped = guests.pop()<br>
print("Sorry " + popped + ", I can't invite you to dinner.")<br>
popped = guests.pop()<br>
print("Sorry " + popped + ", I can't invite you to dinner.")<br>
popped = guests.pop()<br>
print("Sorry " + popped + ", I can't invite you to dinner.")<br>
popped = guests.pop()<br>
print("Sorry " + popped + ", I can't invite you to dinner.")<br>
print("\nDear " + guests[0] + ", you're still invited.")<br>
print("Dear " + guests[1] + ", you're still invited.")<br>
del guests[0]<br>
del guests[0]<br>
print(guests)   # []<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<h3 data-heading="3-8 放眼世界">3-8 放眼世界</h3>
<pre><code class="language-python">places = ['Tokyo', 'Iceland', 'New Zealand', 'Egypt', 'Brazil']
print(places)
print(sorted(places))
print(places)
print(sorted(places, reverse=True))
print(places)
places.reverse()
print(places)
places.reverse()
print(places)
places.sort()
print(places)
places.sort(reverse=True)
print(places)
</code></pre>
<h3 data-heading="3-9 晚餐嘉宾">3-9 晚餐嘉宾</h3>
<pre><code class="language-python">guests = ['Einstein', 'Mozart', 'Curie', 'Newton', 'Da Vinci']
print("I invited " + str(len(guests)) + " guests to dinner.")
</code></pre>
<h3 data-heading="3-10 尝试使用各个函数">3-10 尝试使用各个函数</h3>
<pre><code class="language-python">languages = ['Python', 'Java', 'C', 'JavaScript', 'Ruby']
print(languages)
print(sorted(languages))
languages.sort()
print(languages)
languages.sort(reverse=True)
print(languages)
languages.reverse()
print(languages)
print(len(languages))
languages.append('Go')
languages.insert(0, 'Swift')
print(languages)
languages.pop()
languages.remove('Swift')
print(languages)
</code></pre>
<h3 data-heading="3-11 有意引发错误">3-11 有意引发错误</h3>
<pre><code class="language-python">items = [1, 2, 3]
# print(items[3])   # ❌ IndexError
print(items[-1])    # ✅ 使用 -1 安全访问最后一个
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 data-heading="代码块汇总">代码块汇总</h2>
<pre><code class="language-python"># 创建列表
bicycles = ['trek', 'cannondale', 'redline', 'specialized']
<h1 id="访问元素索引从-0-开始">访问元素（索引从 0 开始）</h1>
<p>bicycles[0]           # 第一个元素<br>
bicycles[-1]          # 最后一个元素</p>
<h1 id="修改">修改</h1>
<p>motorcycles[0] = 'ducati'</p>
<h1 id="添加">添加</h1>
<p>motorcycles.append('ducati')     # 末尾<br>
motorcycles.insert(0, 'ducati')  # 指定位置</p>
<h1 id="删除">删除</h1>
<p>del motorcycles[0]               # 按索引删除（不使用值）<br>
popped = motorcycles.pop()       # 弹出末尾（使用值）<br>
popped = motorcycles.pop(0)      # 弹出任意位置<br>
motorcycles.remove('ducati')     # 按值删除（只删第一个）</p>
<h1 id="排序">排序</h1>
<p>cars.sort()                      # 永久排序<br>
cars.sort(reverse=True)          # 永久倒序<br>
sorted(cars)                     # 临时排序<br>
sorted(cars, reverse=True)       # 临时倒序</p>
<h1 id="反转">反转</h1>
<p>cars.reverse()</p>
<h1 id="长度">长度</h1>
</code><p><code class="language-python">len(cars)<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<hr>
<h2 data-heading="常见错误 / 陷阱">常见错误 / 陷阱</h2>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>错误类型</th><th>说明</th><th>解决</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>IndexError</code></td>
<td>索引超出范围</td>
<td>索引从 0 开始，最大索引为 <code>len(list) - 1</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>空列表 <code>-1</code></td>
<td>空列表用 <code>-1</code> 也会出错</td>
<td>访问前检查列表是否为空</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>remove()</code> 只删一个</td>
<td>重复值只删第一个</td>
<td>用循环处理</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>误用 <code>sort()</code></td>
<td>以为 <code>sort()</code> 不影响原列表</td>
<td><code>sort()</code> 永久修改，<code>sorted()</code> 临时修改</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<hr>
<h2 data-heading="复习要点">复习要点</h2>
<ul class="contains-task-list">
<li class="task-list-item" data-task=" "><input class="task-list-item-checkbox" type="checkbox">列表用 <code>[]</code> 表示，元素用逗号分隔</li>
<li class="task-list-item" data-task=" "><input class="task-list-item-checkbox" type="checkbox">索引从 0 开始，<code>-1</code> 访问最后一个</li>
<li class="task-list-item" data-task=" "><input class="task-list-item-checkbox" type="checkbox"><code>append()</code> 末尾添加，<code>insert()</code> 任意位置插入</li>
<li class="task-list-item" data-task=" "><input class="task-list-item-checkbox" type="checkbox"><code>del</code> / <code>pop()</code> / <code>remove()</code> 三种删除方式的区别和适用场景</li>
<li class="task-list-item" data-task=" "><input class="task-list-item-checkbox" type="checkbox"><code>sort()</code> 永久排序 vs <code>sorted()</code> 临时排序</li>
<li class="task-list-item" data-task=" "><input class="task-list-item-checkbox" type="checkbox"><code>reverse()</code> 反转列表顺序</li>
<li class="task-list-item" data-task=" "><input class="task-list-item-checkbox" type="checkbox"><code>len()</code> 获取列表长度</li>
<li class="task-list-item" data-task=" "><input class="task-list-item-checkbox" type="checkbox">避免 <code>IndexError</code>：最大索引 = <code>len(list) - 1</code></li>
</ul>
